en.h2: How it works—and what you walk away with
en.sub: Five stages from a stuck call to a report you’ll use—30-day daily same-line reminders provided together.
en.stage1.title: Name the stuck decision
en.stage1.you: Tell us the decision that won’t leave you alone.
en.stage1.we: Ask follow-ups until the problem is clear.
en.stage1.youGet: Agreement on what you’re actually deciding—before any deep analysis.
en.stage2.title: Deep reasoning + first cut
en.stage2.we: Run multi-step reasoning, give you a first analysis, and list the detail questions we still need.
en.stage2.you: Answer those questions as fully as you can.
en.stage2.youGet: A first map of the decision—and a clear “what’s still missing” list.
en.stage3.title: Collect the details
en.stage3.you: Fill in the follow-ups (skip anything that doesn’t apply).
en.stage3.we: Fold your answers into the case.
en.stage3.youGet: A tighter brief—enough detail to pressure-test real paths.
en.stage4.title: Deliver the report
en.stage4.we: Hand you a main path, a backup, and a decision report you can reopen later.
en.stage4.youGet: Concrete routes—not a chat that disappears.
en.stage5.title: 30-day reminders provided together
en.stage5.we: Include 30 days of daily same-line reminders with every PASS—not a separate purchase.
en.stage5.you: Stay on the same thread for the same decision.
en.stage5.youGet: Follow-through so the clarity doesn’t fade. We advise. You decide.

zh.sub: 五阶段：从卡住的决定到你会用上的报告——同步提供 30 天每日同线提醒。
zh.stage1.title: 说清卡住的决定
zh.stage1.you: 说出一直缠着你的那个决定。
zh.stage1.we: 追问澄清，直到问题说清楚。
zh.stage1.youGet: 先对齐「到底在决定什么」——再往下做深度分析。
zh.stage2.title: 深度推理与初稿
zh.stage2.we: 做多层推理，给你一份初析，并列出还需要了解的细节问题。
zh.stage2.youGet: 决策的第一张地图——以及「还缺什么」的清单。
zh.stage3.title: 收集细节
zh.stage3.you: 按提示补细节（不适用的可跳过）。
zh.stage3.youGet: 更完整的案情——细节够了，才能认真压测路径。
zh.stage4.title: 交付报告
zh.stage4.we: 交给你主路径、一条备用，和一份之后还能打开的决策报告。
zh.stage4.youGet: 能照着走的路线——不是聊完就没的记录。
zh.stage5.title: 同步提供 30 天提醒
zh.stage5.we: 每次 PASS 同步提供 30 天每日同线提醒——不用另买。
zh.stage5.you: 留在同一条对话线、同一个决定上。
zh.stage5.youGet: 持续跟进，不让当时的清楚慢慢散掉。我们给建议。由你决定。
zh.item2: 还能再打开的决策报告
zh.item3: 同步提供的 30 天每日同线提醒
zh.close: 我们给建议。决定权始终在你。
